image_description: Two individuals standing in a desert environment holding firearms. The person on the left holds a rifle with wood furniture and a curved magazine (resembling an AK-pattern). The person on the right holds a black rifle with a pistol grip, straight magazine, and distinct receiver shape (resembling an AR-15/M16 pattern). Both are wearing tactical vests and hats.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both firearms exhibit the classic linear alignment of stock, receiver, and barrel typical of assault rifles.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rifle on the right shows a carry handle/rear sight assembly typical of M16/AR-15 platforms. The left rifle has a side-mounted rail or standard sight base.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Distinguishing features include magazine well and ejection port.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Magazine wells are clearly defined. Ejection ports are visible on the right-side facing weapons.
